integrity: An exact-rational checker of finite algebra is included; infinite convergence is supported by the complete geometric coupling and boundary conservation proof, not finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The exact spectral field is a stationary two-sided comparison; the growing graph is close to it only with an explicit root-distance error. Fixed m and beta; multiplicity-counted lifetime incoming edges. Broader independent-displacement hyperuniformity is prior art. Historical priority of the full quantitative boundary count may require further review.
title: Hyperuniform age-block indegrees and the two-boundary law for exponential attachment
